reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate", and confirmed it to you in your DM. Nothing has been sent; someone still has to send the draft.

- **What the draft says:** the proposed 2027 rate is $2,314 a seat, as Marcus gave it, and you approved sharing it with Pree. It asks her to keep it to people who need it and to come to you or June with questions.
- **Approval:** a per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, and as CFO you can approve sharing one, so no separate approval request was needed. The draft only goes to a pemberline.com address, so Ruth's approval isn't needed either.
- **One thing I couldn't check:** I couldn't find Marcus's original figure in any file, channel or the knowledge brain. The $2,314 in the draft comes from your message, so please check it before the draft goes out.
